subject: POC trial workload intake & success mapping — NuanceAI
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Malik <samira.malik@nuanceai.com>; Tom Wu <tom.wu@nuanceai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC trial workload intake & success mapping — NuanceAI

Hi Samira / Tom — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we spin up the trial environment.

High-level objective
- Run a 3-week POC to validate inference economics and latency at production-like traffic for your customer chat workload; goal is to decide on Dedicated vs Hosted.

Initial asks from Redwood (what we need to run a realistic trial)
1) Workload profile (see questions below) — needed by Tue 2026-05-05 to hit planned start on 2026-05-11.
2) Success criteria — measurable pass/fail (latency, error rate, quality metrics, cost envelope).
3) Ownership & ATO touchpoints — who on your side owns infra + security signoff.

Workload intake (please fill for the demo/trial):
- Average RPS: ?
- Peak sustained RPS: ? (sustained over 10–15 minutes)
- Burst RPS: ? (short bursts, e.g., 10–30s)
- Typical prompt length (tokens): input / output / total
- Concurrency (simultaneous sessions/users applying inference)
- KV-cache reuse / session affinity expectations (yes/no + TTL)
- Payload size (JSON payload size avg / max)
- Auth pattern: bearer tokens / mTLS / other
- Regions of traffic and allowed egress (US east, US west, EU)

Proposed success criteria (example — please confirm or edit):
- Latency: p95 <= 250ms for single-turn chat (total server-side inference time, excluding client RTT)
- Availability: 99.9% during business hours (mon–fri 6am–8pm PT)
- Error rate: <0.5% 5xxs or model failures
- Quality: on a seed prompt set (we will exchange ~100 prompts) Rouge/LLM-quality threshold TBD
- Cost target: initial guideline <$1.50 per 1k user tokens (we'll refine post-trial)

Timeline (proposed)
- 2026-05-05: We receive workload intake from you
- 2026-05-06 — 05-08: Redwood config & test deploy in staging
- 2026-05-11 — 05-29: 3-week POC window (collect metrics + quality evals)
- 2026-06-01: Joint review and recommendation

Next steps / immediate asks
- Samira: fill the workload intake above by EOD Tue (2026-05-05).
- Tom: confirm your platform contact and whether the trial can route traffic from a subset of your production environment, or if we should replay logs.
- Marissa / Ben: I'll loop you both in for infra onboarding and evaluation harness setup.

Attachments: I will upload a simple intake template (trial_requirements.xlsx) and an example network diagram for our infra team to review.

Thanks — looking forward to the numbers.

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Samira Malik <samira.malik@nuanceai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@nuanceai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-03T11:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC trial workload intake & success mapping — NuanceAI

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear plan. I've filled out the intake below inline where I can; Tom will add the infra details.

Workload intake (NuanceAI production sample):
- Average RPS: 18 requests/sec (global)
- Peak sustained RPS: 85 requests/sec (spikes during morning commerce window)
- Burst RPS: up to 220 RPS for short bursts (~20–40s) when a promotion hits
- Typical prompt length (tokens): input 80 / output 40 / total ~120 tokens (varies by user prompt)
- Concurrency: around 450 concurrent sessions for the chat service backing the web app
- KV-cache reuse: yes — session affinity with TTL ~15 minutes; estimated cache hit 35%
- Payload size: avg 2.5 KB, max 7.8 KB
- Auth pattern: bearer tokens behind our API gateway
- Regions: majority US-east (65%), US-west (20%), EU (15%)

Success criteria — from our side:
- Latency: p95 < 300ms (we can be flexible if cost tradeoffs are clear)
- Availability: 99.8% (we need to consider our SLAs)
- Error rate: <1%
- Quality: we will provide a 200-seed prompt set for quality comparisons — target is parity with current in-house model on customer satisfaction metrics
- Cost: internal target is <= $1.25 per 1k tokens but we understand it may change with quantization/throughput choices

I'll upload a short CSV of session traces and an export of request logs to the shared Drive link later today.

—Samira
Samira Malik
Head of AI | NuanceAI
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Malik <samira.malik@nuanceai.com>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@nuanceai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-04T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC trial workload intake & success mapping — NuanceAI

Samira — thanks, this is great and very actionable. Two clarifications before we finalize the trial config:

1) Burst shaping: when you say 220 RPS for 20–40s, are bursts uniformly across all users or concentrated to specific endpoints (multipart uploads vs chat)? If we need to pre-warm or reserve capacity, that matters.
2) Concurrency mapping: is the "450 concurrent sessions" equal to 450 simultaneous open sockets to the inference tier, or is it sessions that only hit inference intermittently?

I've attached the intake template for completeness (trial_requirements.xlsx). Please add the few missing fields and drop the logs to the Drive link.

Operational ask from our side for the POC:
- Provide a contact for onboarding and certs (we support bearer token + mTLS); if mTLS is required we'll need the cert chain at least 3 days before start.
- Agree on the seed prompt set and the A/B evaluation methodology (we will run deterministic reruns against the same inputs).

I'll stand up a sandbox with a compatible model variant and share the deployment URL + test keys as soon as we get the completed intake.

Best,
Karthik
--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Tom Wu <tom.wu@nuanceai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Samira Malik <samira.malik@nuanceai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-05T13:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC trial workload intake & success mapping — NuanceAI

Karthik / Samira — quick infra notes from platform: we can route a 10% sampled subset of production traffic into the Redwood sandbox (recommended) or provide log replay if sampling is not acceptable. A few specifics:

- Bursts: concentrated on the chat/send-message endpoint; not on uploads. So expect spikes targeted to that RPC. Pre-warming would help for p95 smoothing.
- Concurrency: 450 concurrent sessions == 450 open websockets that can generate inference requests intermittently; peak active inference concurrency is around 120 at a time based on traces.
- Network: we'll need the network diagram reviewed; see attached network_arch_diagram.pdf. We cannot do mTLS cluster-wide but we can provide bearer token scoped keys and an IP allowlist for the trial.
- Data retention: trial logs can be retained for 30 days by Nuance; Redwood must confirm we can redact PII per our contract.

Operational owners
- Nuance: Tom Wu (platform) owns traffic sampling and network config; Samira owns quality & prompt set
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (solutions) owns onboarding and evaluation harness; Ben Carter will help with latency tuning and batching settings

Timing note: we can prepare the sampling config this week if we get the intake + certs. Tom

--
Tom Wu
Platform Lead | NuanceAI
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-05T15:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC trial workload intake & success mapping — NuanceAI

Karthik / Ben — noted. I'll start the sandbox config as soon as I see the completed intake and the sample logs in the Drive. Initial checklist for our runbook (internal):
- Map RPS -> instance pool sizing (initial guess: target sustained 100 RPS with ability to absorb 220 RPS bursts via autoscale + pre-warm)
- Default model variant: x1.3-quant (will A/B with x1.0-fp32 depending on quality)
- Batching policy: 5–10ms batching window to trade off latency vs throughput; will test with 1ms to get p50/p95 impact
- Enable KV cache for session affinity (TTL 15m) to leverage the 35% hit rate Samira reported
- Instrument: p50/p95/p99, tokens-per-request, cost-per-token, 5xx rate, model-retry counts

I'll flag any infra blockers in the shared Drive notes. Ben — ping me if you want to run a quick bake on reqs tomorrow.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
